recognize_zh: 骨髓抽吸片滿布大型圓核細胞，細胞質邊緣深藍、核周稍淡染，染色質細顆粒狀，為原紅血球母細胞（proerythroblast）與嗜鹼性紅血球母細胞，並夾雜少數較成熟紅系細胞，紅系前驅細胞呈片狀增生，支持純紅系白血病。
features: Sheets of large erythroid precursors with round nuclei and finely granular chromatin
Deeply basophilic cytoplasm forming a rim, with perinuclear pallor in some cells
Admixed smaller erythroblasts with condensed chromatin and polychromatic cytoplasm
Rare small lymphocytes and granulocytes; red cells in background
describe_en: Bone marrow aspirate smear shows a markedly hypercellular field composed predominantly of erythroid precursors. Most cells are large proerythroblasts and basophilic erythroblasts with round nuclei, finely granular chromatin and rims of deeply basophilic cytoplasm, admixed with smaller maturing erythroblasts showing condensed chromatin. Occasional erythroid cells are binucleate or have irregular nuclei, and granulocytic cells are scarce. Findings are consistent with pure erythroid leukemia, pending differential count and immunophenotyping (e.g. E-cadherin, CD71, glycophorin).

ddx.vs: Megakaryoblasts also have basophilic blebbing cytoplasm but are CD41/CD61 positive and E-cadherin/glycophorin negative.
MDS lacks the ≥30% proerythroblast population and >80% erythroid predominance of pure erythroid leukemia.

ddx.dx: Metastatic small round blue cell tumor or lymphoma
ddx.vs: These are non-erythroid and negative for E-cadherin, CD71 and hemoglobin/glycophorin, expressing their own lineage markers.
Parvovirus causes scattered giant proerythroblasts with glassy intranuclear inclusions in a background of red cell aplasia rather than sheets of erythroid precursors.
